text: Firms that outsource the chief compliance officer role to third parties face heightened SEC scrutiny and examination risk, and the SEC has signaled that CCO liability arises where CCOs mislead regulators, engage in affirmative misconduct, or fail to carry out assigned compliance responsibilities.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Post Dodd-Frank Act Evolution of the Private Fund Industry Comparative Evidence from 2012 and 2 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2739479
